summary: Welcome page and Footer V2 light/dark theme compliance testing completed successfully. All critical elements use runtime V2 theme tokens from useTheme().colors. Theme toggle works correctly with three modes (light/system/dark). Both light and dark modes render with proper contrast and token-based styling.
critical_code_review_comments: All Welcome section components (WelcomeHero, WelcomeBenefits, WelcomePricing, WelcomeCTA, WelcomeMetrics, WelcomeLiveTickertape, WelcomeCapabilityMatrix) correctly use useTheme().colors as the single runtime theme source
Footer.tsx uses colors from useTheme() for all structural chrome - footerBg, borderColor, brandWhite, mutedText, dimText, linkText, accentTeal are all derived from colors object
EnterpriseAIDisclaimer.tsx uses colors from useTheme() for modal backdrop (withAlpha(colors.overlay, 'D9')), card background (colors.card), border (colors.border), and text colors
Theme toggle has proper data-testid coverage: welcome-theme-toggle-light, welcome-theme-toggle-system, welcome-theme-toggle-dark
withAlpha() utility is used consistently for semi-transparent overlays instead of raw rgba values
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 theme compliance verified for Welcome page and Footer. Theme toggle works correctly. All components use useTheme().colors as runtime theme source. No hardcoded colors or raw rgba overlays found in touched components.
